Sakana AI says a 27B model got better by training on its own team

Sakana AI says two rounds of a 27B open model organising copies of itself into a team, then training on the best runs, lifted research scores per output token 1.2 to 1.6 times.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-sakana-mass/

DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus reaches Science with nine Erdős problems solved

Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus, a Gemini-plus-Lean proof agent, solved 9 of 353 open Erdős problems, two unsolved for 56 years, in a peer-reviewed Science paper.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-alphaproof-nexus-science/

Microsoft's Brad Smith says a washing machine faces more safety rules than AI

Microsoft president Brad Smith told ITV that AI is less regulated than a carton of milk, and that the UK could lead on rules Washington has not written.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-brad-smith-washing-machine/

Researchers teach a Unitree G1 humanoid to catch thrown boxes from camera alone
https://theaipost.net/story/find-reflex-humanoid-catch/

Kling team says new diffusion training method cuts GPU hours 12-fold

KlingAI researchers say DiffusionART matched rival reinforcement-learning methods on a 13B video model with about 12 times fewer GPU hours, and removes the need to tune EMA.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-diffusionart-kling/

Palantir CTO says Pentagon already replaced Anthropic

Palantir's Shyam Sankar told CBS the Pentagon's drop of Anthropic had no operational impact because it "has already been replaced", and that AI makers own the liability for defective models.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-palantir-sankar-anthropic/

Grok Bots can now be used by passengers in Tesla's Cybercab

X user Sawyer Merritt says he added laundry detergent to an Amazon cart by voice in a Cybercab, using a Grok Bot that signs out when he leaves.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-grok-bots-cybercab/

Amazon in talks to buy world-model startup Decart for about $7 billion

The Wall Street Journal reports Amazon is in talks to buy Decart for around $7 billion, after Anthropic reportedly walked away from a $6 billion deal.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-amazon-decart-talks/

US restores UK safety institute access to unreleased frontier AI models

The White House has reportedly reversed a decision that cut the UK's AI Security Institute off from unreleased models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-us-restores-uk-aisi-access/

Moonshot executives in talks to settle shareholder dispute before IPO

Reuters reports top executives at Kimi maker Moonshot AI are negotiating a settlement with a shareholder demanding compensation for alleged wrongdoing.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-moonshot-shareholder-dispute/

Veria says its AI agent found a 2015 XRP Ledger bug worth 18 trillion XRP
https://theaipost.net/story/find-veria-xrpl-overflow/

Coinbase's Armstrong says a fine-tuned 9B open model beat frontier models at fraud checks
https://theaipost.net/story/find-coinbase-qwen-fraud/

Karpathy puts people who have watched frontier agents work at about 20 million
https://theaipost.net/story/find-karpathy-llm-funnel/

Hugging Face's Delangue says OpenAI's maths proofs are now open training environments
https://theaipost.net/story/find-fineenvs-openai-math/

Apple tested an Apple TV with built-in Siri microphones, Bloomberg's Gurman reports

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple tested an Apple TV 4K that hears Siri directly, and a remote with a speaker, ahead of an event expected on Tuesday.

https://theaipost.net/story/cc34bd1e4/
